baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coordinated possessive nouns at words 1-2 pair the person's female companion with his sons.
baseline_models.mechanism: Companionship supplies the horizontal axis of chosen, sustained proximity, while filiation supplies the vertical axis of descent and derived belonging. The short phrase therefore spans both intimate partnership and lineage.

activation_trace.role: Close association is the literal core of the first noun and supplies the household's horizontal bond.
Filiation and belonging to an origin are literal for the sons and supply the household's descending axis.

changed_reading.before: The ayah merely adds a wife and sons to a list of relatives.
changed_reading.after: The ayah names the two relations that extend a person sideways through intimacy and forward through descent.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The roots of both focus nouns carry keeping and load-bearing images.
baseline_models.mechanism: A companion can be the care that stays with and protects, while sons can be imagined as ribs or house-posts on which settled life rests. Together they form a protective household frame, not just a genealogical inventory.

activation_trace.role: Protective accompaniment turns the companion into continuing care and shelter.
Ribs and house-posts make the sons a figurative support-frame for settled life.

changed_reading.before: The wife and sons are people emotionally close to him.
changed_reading.after: They are the normally protective and load-bearing structure of his settled life.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus order moves from the female companion at word 1 to sons at word 2, while the sons-root itself includes both bridal union and filiation.
baseline_models.mechanism: The phrase can compress a household biography: two lives are fitted together, conjugal union establishes a household, and descendants issue from it. The nouns are then successive phases rather than two static categories.

activation_trace.role: Making two things accompany and fit supplies the joining stage of household formation.
Consummation under a bridal shelter supplies the transition from companionship into an established union.
Filiation supplies the resulting descendants and closes the compressed temporal sequence.

changed_reading.before: The ayah lists two simultaneous household relations.
changed_reading.after: The ayah telescopes the making of a household from joined companionship to generated lineage.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening failures of facing and attention activate the durative force of companionship. Flight from the companion then reads not only as spatial separation but as the terminal impossibility of staying present even to the person defined by staying-with.

activation_trace.role: Sustained close association anchors the focus noun as a relation constituted by remaining present.
Turning away supplies the opening counter-motion to companionship and makes relational orientation salient.
Being occupied by one thing away from another supplies the earlier failure of available attention.

structural_cues: The surah opens with turning away, repeats diversion from a seeker, and later places flight from the closest companion inside the same movement away from another person.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies turn-away, diverted attention, and sustained companionship; I infer an ethical echo from failed public attention to eschatological inability to stay present. A live alternative is that the later flight expresses panic only and does not replay the opening relation.

changed_reading.before: He physically flees another close relative.
changed_reading.after: The one relation named by staying-with becomes the sharpest measure of a total collapse in the capacity to attend and remain present.

context_deltas.mechanism: The creation-and-provision sequence activates the focus phrase as a causal biography. Conjugal union leads to offspring from a minute fluid source; feeding and upbringing build those offspring into a human continuation. Flight is therefore from a future the person helped generate and nourish.

activation_trace.role: Bridal consummation supplies the focus phrase's generative household threshold.
Filiation identifies the sons as beings derived from and belonging to that household origin.
Food building flesh makes nurture materially constitutive of the descendants, not merely external support.
The fluid branch extending from a drop to semen supplies the minute bodily origin of generated life.
Feeding another supplies the caregiving transfer by which descendants are sustained.
Human emergence and upbringing turns plant growth into a supplied analogy for raising children.

structural_cues: Before the kin-flight sequence, 80:18-32 moves through human creation, measured embodiment, food, water, earth, growth, and provision; the focus itself orders companion before sons.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bodily origin, feeding, human upbringing, bridal union, and filiation; I supply the temporal arrow union to offspring to nurtured continuation. The live alternative is that the provision sequence concerns each person's own body and does not specifically narrate parenthood.

changed_reading.before: The sons are close dependents from whom the person flees.
changed_reading.after: The sons are his generated and nourished continuation, so flight severs him from an embodied future he participated in making.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ordered relatives create a kinship topology: the brother is collateral relation, mother and father are origin and upbringing, the companion is the chosen household bond, and sons are descent. The focus ayah completes the traversal from inherited past to generated future.

activation_trace.role: Close companionship supplies the chosen horizontal bond that follows the relations of birth.
Filiation and derived belonging supply the descending and future-facing endpoint.
Brotherhood and kinship supply the collateral relation from the same generation.
Mother as origin, gathering point, and return supplies the lineage's source and center.
Fatherhood joined to upbringing supplies the other ascending source and formative care.

structural_cues: The uninterrupted list crosses 80:34-36 in the order brother, mother, father, companion, sons, moving from collateral kin through origins to the person's own household and descendants.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered kin terms and their branch relations; I infer a directional genealogy from collateral to ascending to conjugal to descending ties. A live alternative is an affective ranking by intimacy or rhetorical rhythm rather than a designed family topology.

changed_reading.before: The focus ayah is one more pair in an escalating list of loved ones.
changed_reading.after: It is the closing turn of a complete kinship traversal, carrying the list from the family one receives into the family and future one forms.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus household first appears as protective accompaniment and structural support. Escape reverses that normal direction, while the branch of dependents as weight makes a second live model possible: those who usually support or are supported become claims the person cannot carry.

activation_trace.role: Protective accompaniment establishes the companion's ordinary keeping function before its reversal.
Ribs and house-posts establish sons as settled supports within the household frame.
Literal escape supplies the force that reverses accompaniment and abandons the support-frame.
The branch of dependents as weight activates the household as an urgent load or claim rather than available aid.

structural_cues: The single flight construction governs every kin item through the focus, and 80:37 immediately distributes a consuming affair to every individual.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies protection, supports, escape, and a dependents-as-weight branch; I infer a reversal in which mutual support becomes an unserviceable claim. Alternatives remain live: he may flee expected accountability, fear their claims, or simply be unable to seek their aid.

changed_reading.before: The catastrophe deprives him of the household members who normally protect and support him.
changed_reading.after: The catastrophe reverses the household's load-bearing relation: its closest supports also become claims he cannot answer or carry.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated sufficiency root changes valence across the surah: early self-sufficiency is a posture that attracts attention, while after the focus each person's affair supplies a compulsory sufficiency. The flight from companion and sons can thus be read as zero surplus capacity rather than hostility toward them.

activation_trace.role: Close association establishes the relational capacity that compulsory self-containment suspends.
Filiation establishes a normally nonoptional belonging that even saturated individuality cannot service.
Chosen self-sufficiency supplies the earlier social posture whose later form is forcibly transformed.
Adequacy and sufficiency supply the later image of one affair fully consuming each person's capacity.
The affair, condition, or grave matter names what fills that now-private field.

structural_cues: The same sufficiency root appears at 80:5 and in the verse immediately after the kin list, but the grammatical movement shifts from claiming independence to being sufficed by an affair.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies both sufficiency occurrences, the consuming affair, and close kinship; I infer that sufficiency marks total allocation of attention and concern. A live alternative is instrumental: the affair may make other people unnecessary without implying psychological saturation.

changed_reading.before: He rejects his companion and sons in terror or selfishness.
changed_reading.after: Each person has become a closed field with no relational bandwidth, so even the strongest companionship and filiation cannot cross the boundary.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because ordinary syntax keeps the female companion and sons as separate groups. It remains directly anchored in the focus inventory's image of a son maturing into his father's companion and in the explicit filiation noun. Downstream prose should present it as a diachronic resonance within the pair, not as a replacement translation of either noun.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The sons at word 2 stand beside a companion-noun whose root inventory explicitly includes a son grown old enough to become a companion.

activation_trace.role: A son growing into a companion makes the two focus categories overlap across time.
Literal filiation keeps that temporal overlap anchored in the actual sons named by the ayah.

changed_reading.before: Companion and sons are two disjoint classes of loved ones.
changed_reading.after: The sons may themselves ripen into companions, so the ayah also breaks a companionship slowly built across generations.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This material analogy is surprising and form-distant because hide, surface covering, skin, and dust are not lexical meanings of the wife in this construction. It remains root-anchored through two focus companionship branches and gains coherence from the post-focus sequence of uncovering and visibly coated faces. Downstream prose must label it exploratory and use it only as an analogy for social attachments, never as a lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The companionship root at word 1 includes images of matter retained on a hide and a layer covering water, both emphasizing attachment at a surface.

activation_trace.role: Hair or wool kept attached to hide supplies a material image of a relation clinging to and identifying a surface.
A layer covering water reinforces the analogy of companionship as an attached visible covering.
Removal of a covering supplies the later disclosure process against which relational layers are tested.
The appearing skin or surface makes outward disclosure, rather than hidden affiliation, the operative register.
Dust coloring the face supplies the counter-image of a residual layer that remains visibly upon the exposed person.

changed_reading.before: The ayah depicts separation from family members during panic.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it also depicts the stripping away of attached social layers so that the individual surface appears without the household identities that once covered and accompanied it.

strongest_changes: The focus completes a directional kinship map from collateral relation and parental origin to chosen household and descendants.
Protective companionship and filial supports reverse into claims that cannot be carried when every person is saturated by a private affair.
The creation and provision sequence makes the sons an embodied continuation generated and nourished through the household rather than merely nearby relatives.
summary.what_was_special: The two focus roots internally cross: the sons-root contains bridal union, bodily building, and household supports, while the companionship-root contains the striking image of a son maturing into a companion. Context then preserves competing readings of the flight as ethical nonpresence, support reversal, genealogical severance, and compulsory self-containment.
remaining_uncertainties: The kin order may encode genealogy, affective escalation, rhetorical cadence, or several of these at once.
The support-to-burden reading depends on a branch of ك ل ل that is more distant from the surface sense of 'every.'
The nurture and surface-layer models may be deliberate cross-domain activation or productive overextension rather than primary readings.
The packet does not settle whether flight is driven by fear of claims, accountability, inability to help, inability to seek help, or total private preoccupation.
